subject: Re: Follow-up – FOI/EIR Case Ref 00211027 (Llandough Primary School)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Sirs/ Ma'am,

Thank you for your response.

My query regarding the substantive FOI/EIR request is separate from my
request for the identity of the officer who acknowledged my correspondence.

I asked for the name of the officer who sent the acknowledgement email.
Your reply does not answer that request. Instead, it refers to the team's
general practice of issuing correspondence collectively.

If the information is held and you are refusing to disclose it, please
issue a formal refusal notice identifying the relevant statutory basis for
withholding it and advising me of my review rights.

If no individual officer's name is recorded or held in relation to the
acknowledgement, please confirm that expressly.

Otherwise, please provide the information requested.

I look forward to your response.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)

Royal Signals Cyber & Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
